organiser.name: Midsumma Festival (delivers Victoria's Pride in partnership with the Victorian Government)

attendance.note: Organiser-reported via Midsumma's Culture Counts impact report: 84,789 total unique attendees across the 2025 Victoria's Pride program (street party plus regional events), not street party only. Earlier totals: 67,669 (2022), 88,937 (2023), 86,850 (2024).

audience.psychographics: LGBTQIA+ communities and allies; free, all ages and family friendly. Attendees mostly live in metropolitan Melbourne, with regional Victoria at 13% of 2025 survey respondents.

ticket_price.note: Free, no ticket required; noon to 9pm (2027).
